actions.title: Restore the pump station
actions.detail: Dispatch water operations and arrange an alternate supply.

actions.title: Replenish hospital water storage
actions.detail: Arrange tanker supply before Sakra World Hospital exhausts its five-hour reserve.

actions.title: Monitor community hospital reserves
actions.detail: Water backup lasts beyond this window. Confirm resupply arrangements.

briefing: A pump failure interrupts water service to two hospitals. Sakra World Hospital exhausts its water storage after five hours. Varthur Community Hospital retains reserves for the full six-hour window. Restore the pump or deliver water before the hospital deadline.
